subject: design/feature-draft-reopen
statement: A unit is unchanged only when every field except identity and issuance time is equal and every record it relates to is itself unchanged. Memory authorizes a serves link only between active records (feature-draft-v1 S-8), so a tech-spec decision serving a reworded requirement is re-issued to serve the new record, even when its own text did not change. An answer to a reworded question is re-issued the same way. Readiness judges the result as feature-draft-v1 §3.8 defines, over the binding records with the draft's differences applied.
